disclaimer: Guided practical learning over the labs in this repo. Concepts map to Credo PILOT, Broadcom/Marvell photonics vocabulary, Oklo I&C integrity, and Databricks/Netflix data engineering themes. Teaching models are not production silicon or NQA-1 software.

lessons.title: Observation identity & time
lessons.must_know: Every metric needs run/source/interface identity, observation_time vs arrival_time, scrape_seq, collector_epoch, and collection_status. Missing is not zero.
lessons.why: Credo PILOT ingests hardware telemetry into local/cloud pipelines. If identity collapses, you invent rates and false alerts.

practice.task: Open gaps and late_samples_after_restart. Confirm missing stays missing and rates use observation_time.
practice.pass: You can explain why arrival-time intervals are wrong after delivery delay.

check: What fields are required on an Observation?
Why is collection_status=missing different from value=0?

lessons.title: rx_errs ≠ TcpRetransSegs ≠ optical BER
lessons.must_know: /proc/net/dev columns stay separate. TcpRetransSegs is host TCP. Optical/electrical BER is physical layer. Never sum them into one 'errors' series.
lessons.why: PILOT lane BER / eye / SNR must stay distinct from OS packet counters — this is the #1 category error in portfolios.

practice.task: Open Lane for 'Software loss ≠ optical BER'. Read the diagnosis reason aloud.
practice.pass: You refuse to equate netem loss with optical BER in an interview.

check: Name three distinct error concepts and their layers.

lessons.title: Real impairments must traverse the path
lessons.must_know: Same-host TCP can bypass veth/netem. Client and server in separate netns force packets across the impaired link. Ground truth stays in a sidecar; diagnose() never reads it.
lessons.why: Elite evidence: live Ubuntu CI with confirmed delay/loss/cpu, not only constructed fixtures.

practice.task: Open a live Linux delay case. Confirm impairment confirmed and latency moved (~46→350ms).
practice.pass: You can describe netns-veth path and impairment_confirmed gate.

check: Why did early CI show delay with no RTT change?
Where does ground truth live?

lessons.title: Frozen evidence rules & interventions
lessons.must_know: Rules freeze on a calibration split. CPU restriction can look like network to a naive operator. Interventions should help only when the cause matches.
lessons.why: PILOT's value is rigorous insights — not vibes dashboards.

practice.task: Compare live CPU vs naive baseline. Run Intervention on a delay case.
practice.pass: You can state accuracy_when_diagnosed vs network_false_attr.

check: What does insufficient_evidence mean for mixed impairments?

lessons.title: SNR, BER, eye opening
lessons.must_know: Lower SNR raises BER and closes the eye. Teaching curves are not silicon characterization, but the monotonic relationship is interview-critical.
lessons.why: Validation engineers reason in eye/jitter/BER/link margin daily. Credo PILOT surfaces eye diagrams, residual ISI, and lane SNR/BER telemetry.

practice.task: Investigate an SNR-fade lane before revealing ground truth. Note the composite Link Health Score.
practice.pass: You can narrate SNR↓ → BER↑ → eye↓ → health score↓ without peeking.

check: What label should a sustained fade get vs flaps?
What is a composite Link Health Score for?

lessons.title: FEC coding gain
lessons.must_know: FEC reduces residual uncorrectable errors; it does not convert optical BER into TCP retransmits.
lessons.why: Optical links live with pre/post-FEC BER. Software stacks see a different layer.

practice.task: Open the not_netem / FEC demo case.
practice.pass: You can explain pre-FEC vs post-FEC in one sentence.

check: Does FEC make netem loss 'optical'?

lessons.title: Optical-domain impairment
lessons.must_know: Optical cases use domain=optical (OMA/TDECQ-style fade stand-in). Electrical and optical share BER language but different physics knobs.
lessons.why: Marvell photonic fabric roles mix SerDes + PIC measurements.

practice.task: Open an optical OMA-style case and compare to electrical fade.
practice.pass: You note domain in the diagnosis notes.

check: Name two optical metrics you would measure on a real bench.

lessons.title: Jitter-limited eye closure
lessons.must_know: Jitter can close the eye and raise BER with only mild SNR change. Do not force every eye-closure story into 'SNR fade'.
lessons.why: Broadcom/Marvell validation talks FFE/DFE/CDR and jitter budgets separately from mean SNR.

practice.task: Open Jitter-limited lane. Confirm diagnosis label is jitter_limited.
practice.pass: You can separate jitter-rise from SNR-fade in one sentence.

check: What evidence separates jitter_limited from signal_integrity_degrade?

lessons.title: Equalization state (CTLE / FFE)
lessons.must_know: PILOT-style link health includes equalization context (CTLE, Rx FFE taps). Adapting EQ during a fade is visibility — not proof you measured silicon FOM.
lessons.why: Credo Toucan + PILOT surfaces CTLE/VGA/Rx FFE and LTSSM alongside SNR/BER.

practice.task: On an SNR-fade lane, read Equalization state — CTLE rises and adapting=true.
practice.pass: You mention EQ state as supporting context after SNR/BER/eye.

check: Name two EQ knobs PILOT/validation dashboards often show.

lessons.title: Bronze → Silver → Gold
lessons.must_know: Bronze is append-only raw. Silver is cleansed/conformed (SCD2 dims). Gold is curated aggregates for consumers.
lessons.why: Nearly every Databricks posting lists medallion architecture.

practice.task: Run Clean medallion run. Inspect Layers tab.
practice.pass: You can point to bronze quarantine vs gold rows.

check: What belongs in bronze vs gold?

lessons.title: Data contracts & quarantine
lessons.must_know: Null keys, duplicate event_ids, and illegal types quarantine visibly. Silent drops are a pipeline smell.
lessons.why: Netflix and Databricks both emphasize data health / expectations.

practice.task: Open Contract quarantine. Read FAIL expectations.
practice.pass: You refuse silent discard of bad events.

check: List three bronze expectations.

lessons.title: CDC / SCD2 as-of joins
lessons.must_know: Gold attribution uses the dimension version valid at event_time, not the current plan. Sequencing uses change time, not feed arrival order.
lessons.why: AUTO CDC / SCD2 is a Databricks Professional exam theme; late/out-of-order CDC is explicitly called out.

practice.task: Open SCD2 as-of and Out-of-order CDC sequenced. Confirm early converts stay on free.
practice.pass: You can draw valid_from/valid_to and explain sequencing on a whiteboard.

check: What happens if you join to is_current only?
Why sort CDC by change_time before applying?

lessons.title: Late-arriving facts & watermarks
lessons.must_know: Late converts past the watermark are counted for ops visibility; policies are explicit.
lessons.why: Streaming/batch correctness depends on event-time vs processing-time.

practice.task: Open Late-arriving facts. Check late_events ≥ 1.
practice.pass: You can define watermark in one sentence.

check: Event time vs arrival time — which drives the day bucket?

lessons.title: Additive schema evolution
lessons.must_know: New optional columns can appear mid-stream if the core contract (keys, types) still holds. Renames/breaks need a new version.
lessons.why: Databricks Auto Loader / Delta schema evolution themes.

practice.task: Open Schema evolution (additive). Confirm quarantine stays empty while device_fw appears later.
practice.pass: You can separate additive evolution from breaking changes.

check: Would renaming event_id to id pass the bronze contract?

lessons.title: Experiment allocation uniqueness
lessons.must_know: (experiment_id, user_id) must be unique in silver enrollment or causal analysis is garbage.
lessons.why: Netflix Experimentation Platform DE explicitly cares about allocation data health — Spark pipelines over billions of allocation events into Iceberg silver.

practice.task: Compare Experiment allocation health vs Broken allocation uniqueness.
practice.pass: You fail the pipeline when uniqueness breaks.

check: Why is duplicate allocation a hard failure?

lessons.title: Sample-ratio (SRM) & allocation lag SLO
lessons.must_know: Cell shares must match the designed split (sample-ratio / SRM). Peak allocation lag past an SLO fails health even when uniqueness is clean. Netflix uses stratified sampling so cells stay homogeneous across country/device — share skew breaks that.
lessons.why: Trustworthy experiment analysis needs data contracts + data health, not just conversion rates.

practice.task: Open Sample-ratio mismatch (SRM) and Allocation lag SLO breach. Read the data-health gates panel.
practice.pass: You refuse to ship a lift when SRM or lag SLO fails.

check: What does a 80/20 observed vs 50/50 design mean for lifts?
Why measure allocation lag separately from uniqueness?

tracks.title: Advanced fission instrumentation integrity
target_roles: Oklo I&C / controls / software data platforms

lessons.title: Missing ≠ zero (safety)
lessons.must_know: Zero-filling a coolant temperature channel is a safety data bug. Means and trips must ignore or flag it.
lessons.why: Oklo I&C and fuel-fab data roles store high-fidelity process data — integrity first.

practice.task: Compare Missing samples stay missing vs Zero-fill anti-pattern.
practice.pass: You spot zero-fill suspicion and mean distortion.

check: Why is 0°C as 'ok' coolant suspicious?

lessons.title: Trip setpoints on trusted samples
lessons.must_know: Trips fire only on status=ok values. Stale/failed channels must not invent crossings.
lessons.why: Protective functions require trustworthy measurement state.

practice.task: Open High-temp trip and Sensor failed. Compare trip results.
practice.pass: You can explain why failed channels withhold values.

check: Should a stale frozen value keep re-firing trips?

lessons.title: Multi-channel process integrity
lessons.must_know: The same missing≠zero and trip-on-ok rules apply across channels (coolant temperature and neutron flux). Channel identity stays in the series.
lessons.why: Reactor data platforms and SCADA historians hold many tags; integrity is per-channel, not a global fill. Oklo I&C roles span neutron instrumentation and process measurement.

practice.task: Open High neutron flux trip. Confirm unit and channel labels.
practice.pass: You treat flux and temperature as separate trusted streams.

check: Why share trip logic but not fill values across channels?

lessons.title: Physics-result store & reproducibility
lessons.must_know: Reactor physics results need design_id + code + git_sha identity. Missing keff stays null. A/A reruns on the same sha must match within tolerance; different shas are code drift, not A/A.
lessons.why: Oklo Software Engineer postings emphasize storing reactor data/physics results, multiphysics CI/CD, and reproducible analysis pipelines.

practice.task: Open Reproducible physics A/A, Missing keff stays missing, and Code revision drift. Use Physics store tab.
practice.pass: You can explain manifest identity and why keff=null fails validation.

check: What fields identify a physics result?
Why is a different git_sha not an A/A?

tracks.title: Release regression & A/A discipline
target_roles: any reliability / DE role shipping analysis changes

lessons.title: Declare the metric before comparing
lessons.must_know: A/A must not alarm. Deliberate regressions must. Collector changes can look like product changes if analysis drifts.
lessons.why: Prevents self-fooling when you 'improve' a pipeline.

practice.task: Run A vs A, then Deliberate regression.
practice.pass: You state primary metric and threshold before looking at B.

check: What is an A/A false alarm?
